title: York Middle School
subtitle: Outer Banks, NC · May 19–21, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families are currently viewing York Middle School’s sample itinerary. This version provides a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As departure nears, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates.

Day 1: Travel to the Outer Banks & the Wright Brothers National Memorial

  • Depart for the Outer Banks
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Arrive in the Outer Banks and meet your Landmark Tour Manager
  • Visit the Wright Brothers National Memorial
  • Group sit down dinner
  • Admission to Jump Masters
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 2: Jockey’s Ridge, Roanoke Island & the NC Aquarium

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit Jockey’s Ridge State Park
  • Visit Roanoke Island Festival Park
  • Sit down lunch
  • Visit the North Carolina Aquarium on Roanoke Island
  • Sit down dinner
  • Evening activity at Professor Hacker’s Lost Treasure Golf
  • Return to hotel accommodations

Day 3: The Cape Hatteras Lighthouse

  • Breakfast included with hotel
  • Visit the Cape Hatteras Lighthouse
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Depart for home
introHeading: York Middle School, get ready for an unforgettable Outer Banks adventure in 2027! 🏖️
introText: From the dune where the Wright brothers first flew to the black-and-white spiral of the Cape Hatteras Lighthouse, this trip brings the history and wild coastline of the Outer Banks to life at every turn. Students will climb the dunes at Jockey’s Ridge State Park, step aboard the Elizabeth II at Roanoke Island Festival Park, come face to face with the creatures of the North Carolina Aquarium, and let loose at Jump Masters and a round of adventure golf. It’s the perfect blend of education, exploration, and fun—an experience your students will be talking about long after the trip ends.
